label: Crema
note: Heavy cream mixed with buttermilk; softer, tangier and thinner than sour cream, close to crème fraîche; some versions have salt or lime juice

about.text: Mexican and Central American cultured cream, prepared from heavy cream and buttermilk and sold fresh; thinner, tangier and softer than US sour cream, closer to crème fraîche. Used on tacos, soups, beans and roasted corn.
